rationale: C06 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It uses the same monument-boundary machinery: a recital finding lands unnecessary for the care, management, and protection of scientific objects; an operative exclusion of legally described parcels; and an immediately following withdrawal of the excluded lands from application, location, settlement, entry, or other appropriation until further Interior Department order. C09 and C17 contain closely related machinery, but C06 is the strongest match in language, sequence, subject matter, and temporal proximity.

shared_material.child_excerpt: certain hereinafter-described lands ... are no longer required for the proper care, protection, and management of the objects of scientific interest ... and it would be in the public interest to exclude such lands from the monument
shared_material.parent_excerpt: certain lands which are not necessary for the proper care, management, and protection of the objects of scientific interest ... [and] it would be in the public interest to exclude [them] from the Colorado National Monument
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel factual predicate and public-interest finding, with only minor changes in word order and the monument involved.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the following-described lands are hereby excluded from the Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Monument, and the boundaries of the monument are revised accordingly
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The following-described lands in the State of Colorado are hereby excluded from the Colorado National Monument ... As affected by the exclusions and additions made by this proclamation, the boundaries of the Colorado National Monument are as follows
shared_material.explanation: Both use a parcel-by-parcel proclamation to exclude lands and revise monument boundaries.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall not be subject to application, location, settlement, entry, or other form of appropriation under the public-land laws until further order of an authorized officer of the Department of the Interior
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall not be subject to application, location, settlement, entry, or other forms of appropriation under the public-land laws or disposal under other laws until further order of an authorized officer of the Department of the Interior
shared_material.explanation: This is an almost verbatim replication of the distinctive temporary-withdrawal clause following the exclusion.
